title: Derived pullback preserves open support
statement: Let d, t and o be the ordinary or vertical pro-etale geometric and operation data [def-sf-open-normalization-data]. For every object M of the derived category of the restricted coefficient ring on U, Lg*(j! M) belongs to the essential image of j! from U prime. No natural transformation, normalization or identification of its value on restriction is included in the assertion.

source.place: Tags 04J0, 0E8I and the comparison of composite adjoints; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YY, 0G7E and 06YS. This open-support consequence is the unnormalized subargument of the parent proof.

proof.text: For each supplied Pullback record, choose a flat-term K-flat resolution of every complex. Identify the sectionwise tensor exactness predicate with the monoidal tensor predicate. The supplied flat-model comparison makes epsilon invertible on this resolving class, and its naturality shows that ordinary pullback followed by localization inverts quasi-isomorphisms between resolving objects. Resolving-class essential constancy and the pointwise Kan-extension bridge imply absoluteness. The implementation reuses the proved private pro_absolute helper of DerivedCoefficientMapDescent; it does not assume its public coefficient-map conclusion.

Module sheaves on either target site admit K-injective resolutions. Their canonical right derived direct images are absolute. Apply the derived-adjunction theorem to each ordinary pullback/direct-image adjunction, using the preceding left-derived absoluteness. This identifies each specified pullback as a left adjoint of the canonical derived direct image, without changing its presentation.

Restriction is exact, and the restriction on the base-changed open preserves K-injectives because it is right adjoint to exact open extension. The canonical right-derived composition comparisons therefore derive the rightSquare already supplied by Operations. Compose the derived open-extension adjunctions with the two derived pullback adjunctions. Transport one composite adjunction along the derived rightSquare, and apply uniqueness of left adjoints. Its component at M gives an isomorphism from the pullback of open extension to open extension of the corner pullback. The latter object witnesses essential-image membership. This argument is uniform in Mode and uses no normalized base-change map.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YY, 0G7E, 06YS; derived adjunction and uniqueness of composite left adjoints. G5 shorter proof derives the rightSquare supplied by Operations using exact restriction and K-injective composition. Flat resolutions are used only to establish absoluteness of the specified pullbacks. No extension-preserves-K-flatness or normalized exchange theorem is needed.
